name: THE Touhou Datsui Hanafuda
source:
It's again summer national tournament time, so Mahjong Club sets a training camp. But former mentor has graduated, so new director must be elected. There is no common ground in this question, so strip mahjong competition is held to determine the next director.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
又到了夏季全国大赛时间，麻将社设置了训练营。但以前的导师已经毕业了，所以必须选举新的主任。这个问题没有共同点，所以举行脱衣麻将比赛来确定下一任导演。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
